config.env_vars: SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY SENTRY_DSN:SENTRY_WORKERS_DSN SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN SENTRY_ORG SENTRY_PROJECT=workers GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID GOOGLE_OAUTH_SECRET MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID MICROSOFT_OAUTH_SECRET AUTH_CALLBACK_URL

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:config && pnpm run dev:start
scripts.dev:config: ../../scripts/gen-env development $npm_package_config_env_vars > .dev.vars && for dir in $npm_package_config_workers; do cp .dev.vars "$dir/"; done
scripts.dev:start: wrangler dev --env development --test-scheduled $(for dir in $npm_package_config_workers; do echo -c "$dir/wrangler.toml"; done)
